task_instance: Applied the skill's 6-step triage checklist to a real bug in a small Node.js task-search module: a test failed with `SyntaxError: Invalid regular expression` because searchTasks() built a RegExp directly from untrusted user input, so a query containing an unterminated character class (e.g. '[brackets') crashed instead of matching. Reproduced the failure, localized it via the stack trace to the searchTasks function, reduced it to a one-line repro, fixed the root cause (replaced unsafe new RegExp(query) with a literal case-insensitive substring match), added a regression test, and verified end-to-end (full suite green, syntax/build check green, and confirmed the new tests fail against the old buggy code and pass against the fix).
evidence: Project at proj/ (src/tasks.js, test/tasks.test.js). Step 1 Reproduce: `node --test test/tasks.test.js` failed with 'Invalid regular expression: /[brackets/i: Unterminated character class' at tasks.js:20 in searchTasks. Step 2 Localize: stack trace pointed directly at searchTasks (not test pollution/unrelated code). Step 3 Reduce: isolated to `node -e "new RegExp('[brackets').test('x')"` throwing the same SyntaxError. Step 4 Fix root cause: rewrote searchTasks to do `t.title.toLowerCase().includes(query.toLowerCase())` instead of constructing a RegExp from user input. Step 5 Guard: added 'finds tasks with special characters in the query' and 'does not throw for other regex-metacharacter-heavy queries' regression tests. Step 6 Verify: `node --test test/tasks.test.js` -> 3/3 pass; `node --check src/tasks.js` and `node --check test/tasks.test.js` -> both pass (build/syntax check). Additionally verified the guard is real by temporarily restoring the old buggy searchTasks implementation and rerunning the suite: 2 of 3 tests failed (pass 1, fail 2) confirming the regression tests fail without the fix, then restored the fixed code and reran to confirm 3/3 pass again.
